codes.log_rate_cap: Log generation is at the service objective's log rate cap. The cap does not rise with more vCores in the same tier.
codes.maintenance_log_volume: An index or statistics maintenance job generates the log and IO volume that crowds out other work.
codes.parameter_sensitive_plan: A plan compiled for one set of parameter values is reused for values that need another plan.
codes.query_store_read_only: Query Store has stopped capturing, so its reports are stale and the features that depend on it are off.
codes.forced_plan_orphaned: A change of query text gave the query a new identity, and a forced plan or hint no longer applies to it.
codes.memory_grant_capped_by_hint: A hint or setting caps the memory grant below what the query needs, so it spills to tempdb.
codes.lock_escalation_blocking: A long set-based write holds a table-level lock and blocks the transactional workload.
codes.lock_order_deadlock: Two code paths take locks on the same rows or pages in different orders.
codes.client_retry_amplification: Client retries multiply the load during an incident, or repeat a write that had already committed.
codes.scan_volume_not_storage_latency: IO waits are high in total because many pages are read; each read is fast and storage is healthy.
codes.plan_recompile_after_failover: A failover or reconfiguration emptied the plan cache, and the next compile produced a different plan.
codes.cpu_capacity: The workload needs more CPU than the service objective provides, with no single query or plan to blame.
codes.memory_pressure: The buffer pool or the grant memory is too small for the workload.
codes.storage_latency: Storage is slow: single reads or writes take long.
codes.stale_statistics: Statistics are out of date, the estimates are wrong, and the plan is poor because of it.
codes.missing_index: A frequent query has no index to seek on.
codes.implicit_conversion: A type mismatch converts a column and prevents an index seek.
codes.tempdb_contention: Allocation or metadata contention in tempdb.
codes.last_page_insert_contention: Many sessions insert at the end of one ever-increasing index and wait on its last page.
codes.long_open_transaction: An idle or long transaction holds locks or keeps row versions alive.
codes.version_store_growth: The version store grows because old row versions cannot be cleaned up.
codes.worker_exhaustion: The database runs out of worker threads or sessions.
codes.connection_pool_exhaustion: The application runs out of pooled connections while the database has capacity.
codes.index_fragmentation: Index fragmentation or low page density is the cause of the slowness.
codes.parallelism_misconfiguration: The degree of parallelism setting is wrong for the workload.
codes.platform_fault: A fault or maintenance event in the Azure platform, outside the customer's control.
